notes.title: Worlds of Nyx v0.7
notes.notes:
The Homeworld update has just been released!
You may now build a house in the Homeworld.
Saving resources from loss now requires storing them in a storage container, which can be built in the homeworld.

Changelog:
-Fixed tutorial
-Moved savegame to game directory
-Added cloud saves
-Added homeworld
-Added building

notes.title: Roadmap / current state of development
notes.notes:
Worlds of Nyx Roadmap
===============================
It's been for a while since the last update.
Development is still going on, currently I'm working on the house building mechanics.
This is the roadmap for the next few months:

Current state of the game
===============================
-Players can teleport to the HyperVR and collect resources
-If time is up before teleporting back, the collected resources are geting lost
-Resources can be exchanged for credits
-Credits can be used for upgrades which increase the gathering capabilities and allow winning boss fights
-There are currently 5 tiers of bosses which can be killed to get trophies

Roadmap
===============================

Features
--------------------------------
-Add a "Homeworld", which is a non-instantiated, permanent version of the HyperVR (done, not yet released)
-Implement house building in the Homeworld (work in progress)
-Add crafting
-Add survival elements (hunger/thirst/tiredness)
-Add enemies in the Homeworld
-Add cloudsaves


Gameplay
--------------------------------
-Resources collected in the HyperVR will be usable for building houses and furniture
-Enemies will wander around the Homeworld and raid the base every now and then
-Add boss mechanics (currently, the bosses are just stupidly punching the player)
-Players will have to hunt to get food and collect water to drink
-Collected resources will have to be put into a storage chest for not loosing them when time is up in the HyperVR
